Files the answer says define `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, which turns the opt-out on:

- `library/common.h` (line 132, unconditionally)
- `programs/ssl/ssl_client2.c` (line 8)
- `programs/ssl/ssl_server2.c` (line 8)

The answer also names `include/mbedtls/private_access.h`, but only as the file that defines the `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE` wrapper and tests the macro, not as a file that turns the opt-out on. I left it out.

ITEMS:
library/common.h
programs/ssl/ssl_client2.c
programs/ssl/ssl_server2.c
